text: You did your fucking webinar, right?
style: Cheeky and mocking, quick, like a best friend about to roast you.

text: Two hours live, bro. The chat was on fire.
style: Hyped and proud, a bit out of breath, a casual American guy talking to his buddy.

text: Cool. Now open your DMs.
style: Flat and deadpan, completely unimpressed.

text: Holy shit, why do I have sixty-three messages?
style: Real panic rising, fast, voice going up at the end.

text: That's everyone who typed "how much" while you were talking.
style: Dry and matter-of-fact, a little smug.

text: Okay, I'll answer them tonight.
style: Trying to sound chill and confident, brushing it off.

text: Tonight you'll fall asleep in that chair with your shoes on.
style: A mocking roast, slow and smug, savoring every word.

text: Last time I replied two days late and they all vanished.
style: Deflated and a bit embarrassed, quieter.

text: Yeah, they went with whoever answered first.
style: Blunt and deadpan, zero sympathy.

text: So I hire a setter? The last one disappeared.
style: Annoyed and frustrated, venting to a friend.

text: Or you plug me into ManyChat.
style: Smooth and confident, a sly little offer.

text: Nah, my leads hate robotic replies.
style: Skeptical and casual, not buying it.

text: Same. I learn your offer, I talk like you, and I wait till they're done typing.
style: Calm and confident, listing it easily, a hint of smugness.

text: And the guys who want free consulting?
style: Suspicious, like raising an eyebrow.

text: They get your free guide. Only the serious ones get your calendar.
style: Cool and decisive, a short beat between the two sentences.

text: And when they say "I'll think about it"?
style: Half joking, mimicking a whiny lead on the quote.

text: I follow up, three times max, and I never beg.
style: Smug and teasing, a little dig at him at the end.

text: Okay... how much?
style: Hesitant and a bit sheepish, a small pause after okay.

text: Look who's asking "how much" now.
style: Triumphant and mocking, laughing at him.

text: It's free to build, so comment SETTY and I'll slide into your DMs.
style: Smooth, smug, a little flirty sign-off.
